title: driftproof receipt
description: A signed, dated record of running one agent skill's eval suite with and without the skill on one model version, with sampled judge scores and confidence bands. Receipt spec v0.3.1 — additive over v0.3: adds run.provider (two-axis provider), expands the surface enum with the OpenAI lanes (openai-api, openai-cli), adds an optional run.surface_overhead_note (fixed harness preamble on the openai/cli surface), optional per-case deterministic post-check results, and an optional skill.tokens count for the value-per-token axis. Interop-additive revision: receipts IMPORTED from external tools (surface 'external', run.source 'imported/<tool>', verification_level DECLARED) may carry null content/suite/rubric hashes and omit generation hashes — hashes are never fabricated; the TESTED tightening (see allOf) requires the full evidence chain whenever verification_level is TESTED, so no previously issued receipt is invalidated and TESTED keeps its meaning.

allOf.description: TESTED tightening — the interop relaxations (null hashes, external surface, null comparison, transcripts 'none') are ONLY available to receipts below TESTED. A TESTED receipt must carry the full evidence chain, exactly as before the interop revision.

content_hash.description: sha256 (hex) over SKILL.md + all bundled files in canonical path-sorted order. Null ONLY on an imported (DECLARED) receipt whose skill bytes were never seen; a TESTED receipt must carry the hash (see the TESTED tightening).

tokens.description: v0.3.1 (optional). Estimated token size of the skill's SKILL.md (a coarse chars/4 proxy, not a model tokenizer), used for the value-per-token axis (delta per 1k skill tokens). See docs/methodology.html.

format.description: Suite format. Driftproof-run (TESTED) receipts are always 'agentskills.io/evals' (see the TESTED tightening); an imported receipt names the source tool's format (e.g. 'skillgrade/eval.yaml').

suite_hash.description: sha256 (hex) over the canonicalized normalized case list. Null ONLY on an imported (DECLARED) receipt whose suite bytes were never seen.

model_release_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the model release if known, else null.

provider.description: v0.3.1. The two-axis provider the target model ran on (registry `provider`, else inferred from the id).

surface.description: 'external' = the run happened on another tool's harness and was imported (never valid on a TESTED receipt).

source.description: Interop-additive (optional). Provenance of a converted receipt, e.g. 'imported/agent-skills-eval' or 'imported/skillgrade'. Absent on receipts Driftproof ran itself.

surface_overhead_note.description: v0.3.1 (optional). Present on the openai/cli surface: states the fixed Codex base-instruction preamble (~12–15k input tokens per call) that the harness prepends and does not control.

status.description: v0.3.1 (optional; default 'complete'). 'incomplete' when >=1 case persistently failed (e.g. failed_timeout) and was EXCLUDED from aggregates. A drift/durability report must not compute a verdict from an incomplete receipt.

failed_case_count.description: v0.3.1 (optional). Number of cases marked failed_timeout (excluded from aggregates).

date_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the run finished.

registry.description: Whether model_id resolved in the model registry (config/models.json). 'unregistered' means the run still executed but the model was unknown, so cost estimates used the conservative default price.

transcripts.description: Transcript retention for this run. 'hashes-only' = only the sha256 hashes in results.cases are kept (the default). 'retained-local' = the raw generations + judge outputs were also written to transcripts/<receipt-id>/ (gitignored by default). 'none' = nothing retained, not even hashes — ONLY honest on an imported (DECLARED) receipt.

judge.description: Judge sampling settings for this run.

temperature.description: Judge temperature when the surface allows setting it (api -> 0), else null (cli -> surface-controlled).

sampling.description: How sampling params were controlled, e.g. 'api-temperature-0' or 'surface-controlled'.

allOf.description: A completed case carries the full sampled band + hashes; a failed_timeout case is recorded WITHOUT fabricated samples (it is excluded from aggregates).

case_status.description: v0.3.1 (optional; default 'ok'). 'failed_timeout' = the case's model/judge call persistently timed out after retries; the case is recorded but EXCLUDED from aggregates/verdicts — no samples/hashes are fabricated for it.

outcome.description: borderline = the threshold lies within mean +/- stddev.

score.description: Alias of mean, kept for v0.1 readers.

stddev.description: Sample stddev of the judge samples (raw band half-width).

generation_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the raw model generation that was judged for this (case, mode).

judge_sample_hashes.description: sha256 (hex) of each raw judge output, one per judge sample. Same length as `samples`.

checks.description: v0.3.1 (optional). Deterministic post-check results for this (case, mode): structural/regex assertions run on the model output ALONGSIDE the judge. Supplementary evidence reported as a separate column — NOT folded into the outcome/band verdict.

rubric_hash.description: Null ONLY on an imported (DECLARED) receipt whose rubric bytes were never seen.

baseline_score.description: Null ONLY on an imported (DECLARED) receipt from a tool with no baseline mode — never a fabricated 0.

delta.description: Null when baseline_score is null (no baseline mode was run).

delta_uncertainty.description: Combined uncertainty of the delta (quadrature sum of the two aggregate bands). Null when delta is null.

verification_level.description: Community verification lattice. FORMAL is reserved/unimplemented in v0.3.

editorial_reviews.description: Optional pointers to external one-shot editorial reviews of this skill (context only; not verification evidence).

receipt_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the canonical receipt JSON with this field omitted.

stddev.description: Suite dispersion: stddev of the per-case means across the suite. A reported summary stat; the drift headline is driven by per-case band-overlap verdicts, not this band.
